rubric_assessment.boundary_correctness: pass: trace is read-only debug/audit data on memory store; no runtime writes added
rubric_assessment.traceability: pass: trace records memory id, status, kind, scope, source_turn, source_record_id, validity window, reason
rubric_assessment.isolation: pass: tests cover scope_mismatch and real pipeline excludes other-scope memory
rubric_assessment.invalidation: pass: trace exposes status and expiry/rank reasons; existing stale/half-open tests still pass
rubric_assessment.privacy: pass: trace intentionally omits source_text and summary_text

residual_risks: Trace is last-call only; long-term recall analytics would need append-only query logs later.
Retrieval scoring is still metadata rank only; hybrid BM25/vector remains future work once corpus/query policy exists.
